problem:
The total number of people $V(t)$ who have visited a certain shopping center after $t$ hours is given by the function

$$
V(t)=1\,000+100{\int }_{0}^{t}(2x-6)\,\text{d}x,
$$

where $t>0$ is the time (in hours) since the shopping center opened its doors to the public.

At what time is the number of people visiting the shopping center at a minimum, and how many people are in the shopping center at that time?

choices.value: The minimum is $500$ people after $1$ hour
The minimum is $150$ people after $5$ hours
The minimum is $100$ people after $3$ hours
The minimum is $200$ people after $2$ hours
The minimum is $200$ people after $4$ hours
